annual-classification.derivation: Cedar Framing: 1,200 checks of 10.00 (12,000.00), an ACH of 200.00 recorded as a payment and an allocation (counted once), a 400.00 payment with a 50.00 refund in July, and a 70.00 December payment refunded in January 2027 (stays in 2026): 12,620.00. The 500.00 checks dated December 31, 2025 and January 2, 2027 are other years; the 300.00 card payment is reported by the card network. Rivera 2,500.00 and Summit Roofing 3,000.00 are over the 2,000.00 threshold; Roofing has no W-9 or secured TIN, so it blocks filing. Gulf Painting 1,500.00 is under. 2025 reads its own 600.00 threshold and the 500.00 December check.

package-review-and-handoff.derivation: Preparing is refused while Summit Roofing lacks a W-9 and the paying company has no taxpayer ID. Once both are recorded, the package freezes three payees (12,620.00 + 3,000.00 + 2,500.00 = 18,120.00). The preparer cannot approve it; a 100.00 December payment to Rivera makes approval refuse until the package is withdrawn and prepared again (18,220.00). A Books member without tax filing rights cannot get the file and sees no full taxpayer ID. With the partner unavailable the approved file still downloads and the package stays approved, not filed. It is submitted, rejected, resubmitted and accepted. A missed 600.00 December check takes Gulf Painting to 2,100.00, so a corrected package of four payees (20,320.00) replaces the accepted one, which keeps its submission and outcome.
